<thought>We need the number of unique hydrogen environments, but no SMILES or structure is provided. The only tool that can give us information is proton_nmr_spectra, which according to its description takes no arguments and returns the 1H NMR spectra for a given SMILES string (presumably a default compound). We'll call it to see what compound it uses and then count the distinct signals.</thought>
<action>proton_nmr_spectra</action>
